Those memories are so precious. So glad I can still enjoy it with my own studio. Thanks for always being there for me.

[D9:10] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top

Session date: 11:24 am on 25 April, 2023
[D10:8] Gina: I get it, Jon. Confidence is important in business. I stay motivated by reminding myself of my successes and progress. It also helps to have a good support system. Just focus on why you started this – because you love it! Have faith in yourself, Jon. I do!
[D10:9] Jon: Thanks! Your words mean a lot. Gotta focus on success and why I started. You're right, I love it and that'll keep my confidence up.
[D10:10] Gina: No worries, Jon! Sounds like what I said was helpful. You're incredibly talented and passionate about dance. Don't forget, believe in yourself and your abilities. Tackle any obstacle that comes your way and keep shining!
[D10:11] Jon: Thanks! Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and reach my dreams no matter what.
[D10:12] Gina: Go for it, Jon! You got this! Don't let anything stop you. We're in this together!
[D10:13] Jon: Appreciate your encouragement. We'll keep pushing each other on this path.
[D10:14] Gina: Yeah! Let's keep each other going. We can do it!
Session date: 3:14 pm on 11 May, 2023
[D11:1] Jon: Hi! Since we last spoke I am still working on the dance studio and things are looking up!
[D11:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman in a short skirt with her hands on her hips
[D11:2] Gina: Hi! You're so inspiring taking it on and opening your own studio!
[D11:3] Jon: Thanks! Losing my job gave me the push to finally start my dream business: my own dance studio! Now I'm stepping into the unknown and hoping for the best.
[D11:4] Gina: It must be scary stepping into the unknown but I know you can do it, Jon. With your determination and drive, your dance studio will be a huge success. Keep that positive outlook and keep going!
[D11:5] Jon: Thanks! It's a bit scary, but I just think about my love for dance and how it makes me feel. It's been my stress-buster since childhood!
[D11:6] Gina: Gotcha, Jon! Dance is my stress fix too. As soon as I start, all my worries vanish. It's amazing what we can do for our own mental health with something we enjoy.
[D11:7] Jon: Yeah, Gina! Dancing helps me de-stress. It's where I'm most alive. It's a must-have in my life.
[D11:8] Gina: I get it, Jon. Dance is just me -- I can't picture life without it. It's like air.
[D11:9] Jon: Yep! Dancing is like second nature to me. I'm living my dream by having my own dance studio and teaching others.
[D11:10] Gina: You're living the dream and inspiring others too! Your studio will totally change things for lots of folks.
[D11:11] Jon: I hope so, Gina. I want to create a place for people to dance and express themselves - it's been a dream of mine.
[D11:12] Gina: That's a great dream, Jon! Giving people a place to express themselves with dance is really important. Your studio is gonna make a huge difference. Can't wait to see it happen!
[D11:13] Jon: Thanks! Your help means a lot. Keep you posted on the dance studio progress.
[D11:14] Gina: Thanks! Really appreciate you keeping me in the loop on this cool project. Can't wait to hear more and watch it come to life! Oh, btw, I had an interview for a design internship yesterday! It was so cool.
[D11:15] Jon: Wow, Gina, I'm stoked about this! Taking a risk is scary, but I'm sure following my dreams will pay off in the end. How did the interview go?
[D11:16] Gina: It was great!
[D11:17] Jon: Glad to hear it. Been practicing dance routines lately, it keeps my mind focused and motivated.
[D11:18] Gina: Wow! That's great. Dancing is awesome for staying focused. Wanna show me a routine sometime?
[D11:19] Jon: Sure, Gina! Wanna see one of my routines? Lemme know when you got time and I'll send you a vid.
[D11:20] Gina: Yeah, Jon, I'll watch your routine! So proud of you!
[D11:21] Jon: Thanks a lot! Your help really means a lot. I'll get the video to you soon!
[D11:22] Gina: No prob! Always here to help. Can't wait to see the vid!

[D12:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a pink sign with a message on it
[D12:17] Gina: Keep it up!
[D12:18] Jon: Thanks! Your words really mean a lot. Don't worry, I won't let anything get me down.
[D12:19] Gina: Go Jon! Obstacles are inevitable, but you can do awesome things. Keep going!
